multilog_opts.description: Options passed to multilog to configure log rotation. Note: these are *not* passed as a shell-quoted string in the template; each option is expanded separately below.

directory.description: Base directory where log files are stored (must exist and be writable).

format.description: Log format: 'n' = no timestamp, 's' = seconds since epoch, 'c' = compact human-readable (default 'n80' = no timestamp, 80-byte buffer).

keep_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a log file before rotation.

max_time.description: Maximum age (in seconds) for a log file before rotation (0 = disable time-based rotation).

service_command.description: The full command to execute the service (e.g., path to binary with arguments).
